pages.text: $(thing)12 relics$() in 3 collections of 4: Ruins, Depths and Nest. They drop from every chest, more often from rare chests. Rarely, you get the $(#b8860b)collector$() version.
Display a classic relic in your showcase at the $(l:progress/altar)Altar$(): $(good)+1%$() Shells. Then upgrade it with the collector: $(good)+3%$().
A complete showcase row gives an extra bonus. Displaying is permanent: the relic doesn't come back out.$(br2)Classic relics can be sold, collector ones can't.
pages.title: Showcase
